title: Female Veteran Suicide Prevention Act
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The expanded summary of the Senate passed version is repeated here.)

Female Veteran Suicide Prevention Act

(Sec. 2) This bill directs the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) to identify: (1) VA mental health care and suicide prevention programs that are most effective for women veterans, and (2) such programs with the highest satisfaction rates among women veterans.

summary.headline: A 2016 law directs the VA to find which mental health and suicide prevention programs work best for women veterans and which ones they are most satisfied with.
summary.what_it_does: This law tells the Department of Veterans Affairs to identify its mental health care and suicide prevention programs that are most effective for women veterans. It also requires the VA to identify which of those programs have the highest satisfaction rates among women veterans. The summary does not say whether the VA must publish the results or change any programs.

who_it_affects.how: The VA must review its mental health and suicide prevention programs with women veterans in mind, which could inform the care they receive.
The VA must carry out the review and identify the most effective and most satisfying programs for women veterans.
